tactics: induction l <;> intro l' i h <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_zipWith]

induction l with
| nil => intro l' i h; simp at h
| cons a as ih => intro l' i h; cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_zipWith]
induction l <;> intro l' i h <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp [-List.getElem_zipWith] at h ⊢ <;> simp_all [-List.getElem_zipWith]
